text:
tara: Heads-up — planning a small lift-and-shift onboarding for a handful of legacy customers next sprint. Need to align on minimal bench set, pin policy, and rollback escape hatches.
kevin: +1. What do we consider minimum bench? latency, p95, token-cost, and a tiny qual check?
maria (product): Proposing a tight slice: 10 representative prompts per cohort, p50/p95 latency, token cost per 1k, and top-1 accuracy delta vs current pinned model <= 2%. If any metric fails, we flag canary.
anika (eng-runtime): For lift-and-shift we must support pin->variant fallback (same API surface). Also need quant profiles for faster paths. Perf team: how long to run the 10-sample bench per cohort?
kevin: On r4-like machines, the bench command runs ~45s per model for 10 samples if streaming is on. With 3 variants that's ~3m. Ops can parallelize across cohorts.
maria (product): Good — target: run bench within canary window so we can decide before traffic cutover. Decision gates: bench pass + no error spikes in tracing + <5% error rate on canary.
anika (eng-runtime): Runbook notes: pinning should be editable per-tenant via /admin/catalog/pin, with audit log + auto-fallback to 'compat-variant' after 10m if errors > threshold. I'll sketch the API.
kevin: bench command for ops (example):
```
./bench --cohort beta-lift --samples 10 --metrics latency,p95,accuracy,cost --out /tmp/lift1.json
```
kevin: Will add a small script to upload results to the onboarding dashboard.
maria (product): Customer ask: Can we offer a 30-day opt-in gracepath where they stay pinned to the legacy model but get a discount? We need legal/finance to confirm.
tara: For rollout sequencing, suggest 3 waves: internal QA, 2 small beta customers (low traffic), then up to 10 customers if stable. Each wave requires bench pass + manual sign-off.
anika (eng-runtime): Can we make the bench suite idempotent and cheap? Suggest caching prefix responses and reusing KV caches in canary runs to mimic warm state.
kevin: I'll add cache-warm step to the script. Also: metric thresholds config lives in infra repo -> /configs/onboard/bench-thresholds.yaml.
maria (product): Action items: anika — draft pin API and fallback logic by Wed EOD. kevin — bench script + dashboard upload by Thu noon. tara — customer wave list + comms draft by Thu EOD. I'll loop in finance for the discount ask.
deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled: catalog-canary-beta at 2025-09-12T15:30Z (links: https://ci.redwood/integrations/321).
tara: Thanks — if we can keep the bench slice tiny and automatable, we should be able to move 5 customers next sprint. :thumbsup:
maria (product): Agreed. Keep comms short: "bench pass + 24h observation window". I'll post a short template for customer emails once we have the waves.
kevin: One more thought — add a quick smoke check for embedding schema compatibility for customers using embeddings. If mismatch, auto-escalate to SE.
anika (eng-runtime): Noted. I'll add embedding-schema check to the bench flow and a flag to disable automatic pin fallback for enterprise contracts.
tara: Great. Meeting to surface blockers Friday 11am.
maria (product): I'll create the tracker ticket and ping owners. Thanks all.
